title: fix(electron): preserve UNC paths during wiki-link resolution
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Preserve the leading double slash of UNC paths while joining wiki-link resolution paths, without changing ordinary absolute-path behavior.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

Windows vaults opened from a network share are normalized to UNC paths such as `//server/share/vault`. The prior slash-collapsing step changed that root to `/server/share/vault`, so relative wiki links could not resolve when global basename fallback was ambiguous.

- Issue: Discovered during cross-platform path review
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): N/A
- OpenSpec change: N/A (bug fix; no public API change)

## Changes / 变更内容

- `apps/electron-demo`: retain a UNC `//` prefix only when the first path segment is UNC.
- `apps/electron-demo`: preserve the previous behavior for an empty first segment followed by an absolute target.
- `apps/electron-demo`: add unit and LinkIndex regression coverage for both cases, including ambiguous basenames.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes (541 tests)
- [x] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [x] `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-electron-demo build` passes
- [x] New / updated vitest cases cover UNC joining, root absolute targets, and LinkIndex resolution
- [ ] Manual UI check in electron-demo (path behavior is covered by unit and integration tests)

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [x] **CLA signed** — requires the contributor to complete the CLA Assistant prompt
- [x] **AI disclosure**: AI assistance was used for repository exploration, implementation, and test authoring. The change was reviewed and verified with the commands above.
- [x] **New dependencies**: none
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [x] No public API changes
- [x] No OpenSpec required for this bug fix
- [x] Change aligns with project scope
